title: Who will win stage 11 of the 2026 Tour de France?
background: The Tour de France awards individual stage victories separately from the overall race title.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : The race organizer’s official stage 11 classification, corroborated by contemporaneous reputable sports reporting. 
  Resolution : Resolve to the rider officially classified as the winner of stage 11 of the 2026 Tour de France, including any penalties applied when the stage results are confirmed. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The winning rider’s full name.
